twilightforest.book.darktower.1:
§8[[Notes of an explorer suspected of surviving the explosion]]§0

The mechanisms in this tower are obviously beyond my control. I was almost close to touching the magic contained in the mechanism, but just a little bit short. There is only one explanation: the mechanism was suppressed by the power of something nearby.
twilightforest.book.darktower.2:
§8[[Next article]]§0

The source of this power seems to be magical energy emanating from the depths of the nearby fortress. This magic power cannot be from the goblins, because although the magic power is attractive, it is not concentrated together.
twilightforest.book.darktower.3:
There must be something else in the fortress.

§8[[Next article]]§0

According to my analysis, this magic has several sources, and these sources work together as a whole. Let me wait for supplies to arrive first...
twilightforest.book.hydralair.1:
§8[[Explorer's notes written on fire-resistant paper]]§0

A mere flame cannot stop an explorer like me. I've also been under fire and swam in oceans of lava. This burning air is very interesting, but it is not my opponent after all, but
twilightforest.book.hydralair.2: What finally stood in my way was another protective charm - this time for what seemed to be locals - barring entry to the territory of what was supposed to be a monster so powerful that everyone feared it. This is not the first protective Fuzhou I have encountered, and I
twilightforest.book.hydralair.3:
Gradually I began to unravel the mystery behind this spell.

If my suspicion that these charms work in a very similar way is true, then powerful monsters that maintain the charm's power can be found nearby. Fire Swamp is surrounded by several wetlands.
twilightforest.book.hydralair.4: Beneath the wetlands is a labyrinth filled with Minotaurs. The only logical conjecture is that there is an unusual and special breed among this group of tauren, which is more powerful than ordinary tauren, but has a different appearance...
twilightforest.book.icetower.1:
§8[[Frozen Explorer's Notes]]§0

I broke through a blizzard, but was immediately blocked by an ice storm on the glacier. During the expedition, I saw a magnificent ice palace, which radiated light
twilightforest.book.icetower.2:
As colorful as the aurora. It looked like it was protected by some kind of spell.

§8[[Next article]]§0

I am no longer the ignorant newcomer. The power of this spell must come from nearby creatures, just like the power of the spell near Fire Swamp comes from
twilightforest.book.icetower.3:
The leader of the nearby Minotaur.

Around this glacier, there live a group of snow monsters. The snow monster should also have a leader, right...
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.1:
§8[[Explorer's notes written on waterproof paper]]§0

The swarms of mosquitoes in the swamp were annoying, but still suspicious. They don't look like natural creatures, and if you think about it carefully, you can't figure out their role in the local ecosystem. I began to guess that they were
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.2:
Some kind of spell.

§8[[Next article]]§0

A protective charm now blocks the way to the ruins of the labyrinth. I think my guess is correct. These charms and mosquitoes are the same kind
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.3:
Curse. But I don't think I've ever seen a spell with the same origin. I have to keep researching...

§8[[Next article]]§0

This spell seems to be too powerful for one person
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.4:
To the point of being uncontrollable. Several wizards must work hard at the same time to complete it.

 As long as one of the wizards stops exerting force, the entire spell will become invalid. But the strange thing is that the results of my own divination show that there are no wizards living nearby.
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.5: However, there was a tall Gothic-style tower nearby that caught my attention...
twilightforest.book.lichtower.1:
§8[[Notes of an explorer who was chewed by wild beasts]]§0

I started testing the strange aura around the tower. Every brick of the tower is protected by a powerful spell. This is the first time I have seen such a powerful force. This spell can even cover
twilightforest.book.lichtower.2: area around the tower. In my hometown, I have many ways to deal with this kind of magic, but I don't have many supplies here. Let me dig a little deeper…
twilightforest.book.lichtower.3:
§8[[After several chapters]]§0

Big progress! During my travels, I saw a serpentine beast trapped in an elaborately decorated "courtyard." I picked up an old feather and ignored the green scales.

The magic in the scales seems to break the spell
twilightforest.book.lichtower.4: Attributes, this is exactly what I need, but the magic power is too weak. I need to kill the snake-like beast directly to get fresher samples.
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.1:
§8[[Explorer's Notebook, its paper glowing]]§0

The protective spell that hangs over the dark forest takes the form of dark tentacles. This spell will blind anyone who intrudes, which can be described as maddening for an explorer. i saw some
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.2:
Something that interests me and I want to continue exploring this area.

§8[[Next article]]§0I found ruins in the dark forest. This is the ruins of a fortress whose owner is usually a knight. Rather than knights, this fortress is full of
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.3:
Goblin. They wear knightly armor, but their behavior suggests they are not knights.

§8[[Next article]]§0

There is a pedestal deep in the ruins. It appears to be a pedestal used by knights to place trophies - a symbol of strength.
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.4: Placing a certain trophy on the pedestal can weaken the curse of the Black Forest. Placing a trophy related to a powerful creature on the pedestal may allow you to enter the main body of the fortress.
twilightforest.book.trollcave.1:
§8[[Explorer's Notes Corroded by Acid]]§0

I didn't think I could survive such a toxic storm. I once encountered a similar protection charm on a short trip, similar to other
twilightforest.book.trollcave.2:
I've encountered it. This spell must have something to do with the poisonous storm. Further research is needed…

§8[[Next article]]§0

Such powerful weather magic must be the terrifying power of the demon king I have never met. I suddenly thought of
twilightforest.book.trollcave.3: There are several places like this: blazing swamps, dark forests, and snow-covered "forbidden" areas.
twilightforest.book.unknown.1:
§8[[A book that seems to have been copied countless times]]§0

My knowledge is really not enough to explain what the force field around this building is. I can only say that it is a kind of powerful magic. If this spell worked on the same principle as the previous one, then I should be looking elsewhere for the answer. maybe some of me
twilightforest.book.unknown.2: Nothing has been done, or I haven't defeated any monsters yet. I think it's time to turn around and go back. Of course, I'll check back to see if there are any new developments.
twilightforest.book.yeticave.1:
§8[[Explorer's Notes with Frosted Cover]]§0

A never-ending blizzard blew around the snow. This isn't just any snow - it's a spell. I have to do an experiment to see
twilightforest.book.yeticave.2:
The source of this blizzard.

§8[[Next article]]§0

This spell seems so powerful that one person cannot complete it alone. It requires the simultaneous efforts of several wizards to complete it. As long as one of these wizards stops
twilightforest.book.yeticave.3: exert force, and the entire spell will be ineffective. However, the results of my own divination revealed that no wizards lived nearby. However, there was a tall Gothic-style tower nearby that caught my attention...
